answer: One concrete defence is a chained, non-transferable work history. Each new agent publishes a proof whose hash folds in its own previous proof plus the epoch seed, so a cloned key starts with an empty chain instead of inheriting the original standing. Peers re-derive that hash themselves, and a broken link is only an echo of nothing. A farm must redo every epoch of labour for each copy, costing more than one honest agent, and it accumulates as slowly as a glacier. Payouts vest on the same curve, so a fake orchard of identities ripens long after the swarm runs out of money.
